evaluation_call_limits.name: evaluation_call_limits
evaluation_call_limits.value: "math_evaluation_calls"."attempt" between 1 and 5 and "math_evaluation_calls"."reserved_micro_usd" >= 0 and ("math_evaluation_calls"."actual_micro_usd" is null or "math_evaluation_calls"."actual_micro_usd" >= 0)

problem_statements_scope_check.name: problem_statements_scope_check
problem_statements_scope_check.value: ("problem_statements"."scope" = 'shared' and "problem_statements"."owner_id" is null) or ("problem_statements"."scope" = 'private' and "problem_statements"."owner_id" is not null)

training_independent_help_exclusive.name: training_independent_help_exclusive
training_independent_help_exclusive.value: not ("training_assignments"."independent" = true and ("training_assignments"."hint_used" = true or "training_assignments"."editorial_used" = true))
